name: Kashima (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kashima city emblem in white: a winged device above a ring with a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kashima, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 10 July 1980; the emblem dates from 2 November 1966.

features.role: Kashima city emblem — a winged device above a ring with a small disc
